title: Iceberg, showing curved snow bands, Cape Roberts, (1911) (6173967298)
blurb: Taylor, Thomas Griffith, 1880-1963. Condition: Good; some fading of image.; Part of the collection: Frank H. Boland collection.; Inscription: "2. Iceberg, showing curved snow bands, Cape Roberts. by G.T."--Handwritten on verso.; Title from inscription on verso. Part of a set of 4 stereographs. "These are the only stereo photos in existence of the South Pole area taken by Dr Griffin [i.e. Griffith] Taylor on Mawson Ex. to pole, later the negatives were destroyed by accident."--Handwritten on verso of stereograph 2.
